snippet.title: The PI Guy
snippet.description: The PI Guy shares Private investigator training videos to help you grow your PI business. As the profession of private investigations grows and morphs, so will the PI Guy channel. From surveillance, sales, marketing, business ideas, and more! My passion is in helping train private investigators. When I started as a PI in 2008, I found it very hard to locate any useful information. Most of that information was coveted by veteran PI's in fear that new private detectives posed a great threat to them in the highly competitive business of private investigations. I hope viewers of my videos find value and even some entertainment out of these learning experiences for private investigators.

snippet.title: Deed Stories
snippet.description:
Deed Stories is where forgotten documents come back to life.

We uncover the legal battles buried in county archives, the overlooked filings hidden in land records, and the quiet farmers, landowners, and families who refused to surrender what was rightfully theirs.

From eminent domain disputes and property seizures to century-old deeds and forgotten preservation covenants — we tell the stories where one recorded page changed everything.

In a world driven by authority and assumption, we focus on documentation and truth. Because sometimes the most powerful defense isn’t loud — it’s filed.

Every week, Deed Stories brings you cinematic legal narratives inspired by real-world land conflicts, courtroom reversals, and the resilience of those who protect their legacy.

If you value property rights, land ownership, and the power of knowing what you own — you’re in the right place.

Subscribe and join a community that believes:

What’s recorded matters.

New stories. Every week
